definitions.complexity_thresholds: NumPy linear quartiles across all non-empty image instance counts from the source pool: train2017 Q1=2,Q3=10; val2017 Q1=2,Q3=10. simple <=Q1, medium <=Q3, complex >Q3. Zero annotations are not_available.
definitions.object_position: Bounding-box center assigned to left/center/right and top/middle/bottom using equal thirds of image dimensions.
definitions.relative_size: Bounding-box area divided by image area: small <=1%, medium <=10%, large >10%; this is a geometric size band, not semantic object size.
definitions.relationships: Existing relationship counts use box geometry only. They are not semantic ground truth, action, contact, or interaction labels.

prediction_statuses.available: Saved model label met its configured threshold.
prediction_statuses.not_available: No accepted label; the model abstained below threshold.
prediction_statuses.prediction_failed: A prediction record or calculation failed.
prediction_statuses.not_annotated: The source annotation dataset does not provide this field.

definitions.color_limitations: Coarse family percentages are pixel-level estimates on the EXIF-corrected original image (96x96 sample), not object-level color labels. Encoder-input color stats are separate and may include letterbox padding.
definitions.edge_density: Global edge/texture complexity proxy, not object contour or shape recognition.
definitions.clip_scores: Relative CLIP prompt softmax scores are not calibrated probabilities.
